title: Scorer output (Muse Spark structured output)
description: FINAL (approved 2026-10-27). What the scorer model returns for one TEF Canada Writing or Speaking answer. The model gives levels only; the app derives the NCLC and the /450 range from config (docs/contest/rubric.md section 2). Comments are in English; quotes, corrections and rewrites are in French, copied from or applied to the learner's text.

criteria.description: One entry per criterion of this skill and section (rubric.md section 3). Writing: situation, organisation, clarity, development, lexicon, syntax, spelling. Speaking A: questioning, initiative, exchange, lexicon, grammar, register. Speaking B (contest build, scored on the whole conversation with the AI partner): presentation, argumentation, initiative, exchange, lexicon, grammar, register.

assessed.description: false when the criterion cannot be observed (fallback: initiative and exchange in a single recording without the AI partner); then level is omitted and comment says why.

comment.description: English, one or two sentences, specific to this text.

items.description: Exact quote from the learner's text (French).

level.description: Holistic level. Must lie between the lowest and highest level of the criteria with assessed = true (checked by the app; notAssessed criteria are left out).

half.description: lower/upper only for B1, B2, C1 (two NCLC bands); none for A1, A2, C2.

original.description: Exact span from the learner's text.

criteria.comment: A clear letter to the newspaper that takes a position and keeps it.
evidence: Je suis tout à fait opposé à cette mesure

criteria.comment: Paragraphs are there, but the arguments follow each other without links.
Three arguments, but only the first has an example.
evidence: Par exemple, ma voisine doit prendre deux bus

criteria.comment: Enough for the topic; 'chose' and 'problème' come back often.
Complex sentences are tried; the subjunctive after 'il faut que' is missed.
evidence: il faut que nous prenons une décision

betterPhrasing.why: More precise and better suited to a formal letter.

betterPhrasing.suggestion: Par ailleurs, cette mesure aggraverait la situation des transports.
betterPhrasing.why: A full sentence linked to the previous argument.

strengths: A clear position from the first line.
nextSteps: Link arguments with 'par ailleurs', 'de plus', 'en revanche'.
